tagline.en-MY: Cikgu Kavitha’s after-school centre: one friendly quiz a day about Malaysia and nature.
tagline.ms-MY: Pusat selepas sekolah Cikgu Kavitha: kuiz mesra setiap hari tentang Malaysia dan alam semula jadi.

description.en-MY: A fictional learning centre. General-knowledge questions for all ages; every answer, right or wrong, comes with an explanation. No personal data is collected.
description.ms-MY: Pusat belajar rekaan. Soalan pengetahuan am untuk semua peringkat umur; setiap jawapan, betul atau salah, disertakan penerangan. Tiada data peribadi dikumpul.

greeting.en-MY: Every question is a good question. Ready?
greeting.ms-MY: Setiap soalan ialah soalan yang baik. Sedia?

explain.en-MY: The bunga raya was declared the national flower in 1960.
explain.ms-MY: Bunga raya diisytiharkan sebagai bunga kebangsaan pada tahun 1960.

prompt.en-MY: What is the capital city of Malaysia?

explain.en-MY: Kuala Lumpur is the capital; Putrajaya is the federal administrative centre.
explain.ms-MY: Kuala Lumpur ialah ibu negara; Putrajaya ialah pusat pentadbiran persekutuan.

prompt.en-MY: How many states does Malaysia have?
What is the highest mountain in Malaysia?

explain.en-MY: Mount Kinabalu in Sabah rises about 4,095 metres.
explain.ms-MY: Gunung Kinabalu di Sabah setinggi kira-kira 4,095 meter.

explain.en-MY: The ringgit (RM) is divided into 100 sen.

prompt.en-MY: Which is the longest river in Malaysia?
prompt.ms-MY: Sungai manakah yang terpanjang di Malaysia?

explain.en-MY: The Rajang in Sarawak is the longest, at roughly 560 km.
explain.ms-MY: Sungai Rajang di Sarawak ialah yang terpanjang, kira-kira 560 km.

prompt.en-MY: Which animal is Malaysia’s national animal?

explain.en-MY: The Malayan tiger appears on the national coat of arms.
explain.ms-MY: Harimau Malaya terdapat pada jata negara.

prompt.en-MY: Where in Malaysia do orangutans live in the wild?
prompt.ms-MY: Di manakah orang utan hidup secara liar di Malaysia?

explain.en-MY: Wild orangutans live only on Borneo and Sumatra.
explain.ms-MY: Orang utan liar hanya terdapat di Borneo dan Sumatera.

prompt.en-MY: The Rafflesia is famous for being…

choices.en-MY: one of the largest flowers in the world
the smallest flower in the world

choices.ms-MY: pokok yang tumbuh di dalam air

explain.en-MY: Some Rafflesia blooms grow wider than a metre.
explain.ms-MY: Sesetengah bunga Rafflesia boleh melebihi satu meter lebar.

prompt.en-MY: On which date is Hari Merdeka (Independence Day) celebrated?
prompt.ms-MY: Pada tarikh apakah Hari Merdeka disambut?

explain.en-MY: Malaya gained independence on 31 August 1957. Malaysia Day, 16 September, marks the formation of Malaysia in 1963.
explain.ms-MY: Tanah Melayu merdeka pada 31 Ogos 1957. Hari Malaysia, 16 September, menandakan penubuhan Malaysia pada tahun 1963.

prompt.en-MY: Which fruit is often called the ‘king of fruits’?

explain.en-MY: The durian — famous for its spiky shell and strong smell. (Mangosteen is sometimes called the queen!)
explain.ms-MY: Durian — terkenal dengan kulit berduri dan bau yang kuat. (Manggis pula kadangkala digelar ratu!)

prompt.en-MY: Which sea lies between Peninsular Malaysia and Malaysian Borneo?
prompt.ms-MY: Laut manakah terletak antara Semenanjung Malaysia dan Borneo Malaysia?

explain.en-MY: The South China Sea separates the peninsula from Sabah and Sarawak.
explain.ms-MY: Laut China Selatan memisahkan semenanjung daripada Sabah dan Sarawak.

prompt.ms-MY: Apakah maksud ‘thank you’ dalam Bahasa Melayu?

explain.en-MY: Terima kasih = thank you. The usual reply is ‘sama-sama’.
explain.ms-MY: ‘Thank you’ = terima kasih. Jawapan biasa ialah ‘sama-sama’.

prompt.en-MY: Which gas do plants take in to make their food?
prompt.ms-MY: Gas apakah yang diambil oleh tumbuhan untuk membuat makanan?

explain.en-MY: Plants use sunlight, water and carbon dioxide, and release oxygen.
explain.ms-MY: Tumbuhan menggunakan cahaya matahari, air dan karbon dioksida, lalu membebaskan oksigen.

prompt.en-MY: Sarawak is known as the ‘Land of the…’

explain.en-MY: Sarawak is the ‘Land of the Hornbills’ — Bumi Kenyalang.
explain.ms-MY: Sarawak ialah Bumi Kenyalang — tanah burung enggang.

intro.en-MY: Shall we see how much you know about our country? Get 3 answers right — take your time.
intro.ms-MY: Jom lihat berapa banyak awak tahu tentang negara kita? Jawab 3 soalan dengan betul — perlahan-lahan.

outro.en-MY: Wonderful! Come back tomorrow — there are always new questions.
outro.ms-MY: Hebat! Datang lagi esok — sentiasa ada soalan baharu.

notice.en-MY: Pusat Belajar Cahaya is fictional. Questions are reviewed general knowledge; tell us if you spot a mistake.
notice.ms-MY: Pusat Belajar Cahaya ialah rekaan. Soalan ialah pengetahuan am yang telah disemak; maklumkan jika anda jumpa kesilapan.
